profile_text.body:
Synthesia is a London-based company founded in 2017 that describes itself as the "#1 AI Video Platform for Business." According to its site, its AI video generator lets anyone create professional videos with AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages without mics, cameras, actors, or studios. The company says it is trusted by 90%+ of the Fortune 100 to communicate, train, and upskill teams, and that customers can save up to 90% of time and cost on video production.

The site lists a free plan with 10 minutes of video per month, 9 stock avatars, and AI voices in 160+ languages. Named features include an AI Avatar Generator, Custom Avatars, AI Voice Cloning, AI Screen Recorder, AI Text to Video, Script to Video, PowerPoint to Video, Video Translator, Interactive Avatars, Roleplay Sessions, and an AI Script Generator. Synthesia says the product integrates with existing Learning Management Systems and offers analytics such as views, drop-offs, and completion rates. It states that it is SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant, uses both human and AI moderation, and engages in AI policy work, and it notes that content on its site was generated using artificial intelligence and labeled in accordance with EU AI Act Article 50 requirements.

The company's tracked product is its AI avatar video platform, which carries a noted likeness and consent risk. No litigation or other registry facts are recorded for Synthesia.
